column10: Yesterday was the narrowest range of 7 days. With the trend (close vs 50-day average): buy above its high / sell below its low; stop at the bar's midpoint; target 2R; else exit 15:15.
NR7 that is also an inside day (Crabel's NR7ID). Same orders as NR7.

Central pivot range under 0.15% of price (trend day expected). Close above the CPR and the 20-day average: buy above the previous high, stop below the CPR; mirror for shorts; target 2R; else exit 15:15.
Uptrend (close > 20-day > 50-day average) and closed in the top 30% of its range: buy above the previous high, stop 0.5 ATR below it, target 1 ATR (2R); mirror for downtrends.
Only knowable at the open: if it opens 0.3–1% away from the previous close, trade back toward that close at 9:30 (target = previous close, stop = one gap beyond the open); else no trade.

Only knowable at the open: in an uptrend, if it opens at least 1.5% up and above the previous high, buy above the open + 0.1 ATR after 9:30 (opening-range high proxy), stop 0.3 ATR under the open, target 2R; exit 15:15.
OMEGA washout: market RSI(2) ≤ 10; stock relative strength ≥ 80th pct, above its 200-day average, RSI(2) ≤ 5. Buy next open; stop 2 ATR, target 3 ATR, max 8 days.
OMEGA quick: market RSI(2) ≤ 5 and stock RSI(2) ≤ 2 above its 200-day average. Buy next open; sell on the first close with RSI(2) > 70 or on day 5; 3 ATR disaster stop.
OMEGA daily (non-washout days): top 10% strength, above its 200-day average, RSI(2) ≤ 1. Half size. Buy next open; exit RSI(2) > 70 or day 5; 3 ATR disaster stop.

v=1: Back-test on 259 sessions of NSE bhavcopies (daily bars). Fill/exit order from the OHLC path assumption (up-close day: open-low-high-close; down-close day: open-high-low-close); a gap through the trigger fills at the open; no stop/target hit = exit at the close (15:15 proxy). Costs 0.10% (intraday) / 0.25% (swing) per round trip.

Only rules with >= 30 back-test trades and a positive average R (path model) are listed; the worst-case column assumes the stop was hit whenever the day reached it. Past results on one year of data are not a promise. Size: ₹1,00,000 capital, 1% (₹1,000) risk per trade.
Market proxy for the swing modes: equal-weight index of liquid NSE stocks (not the official Nifty 500).
